main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: From Material Prison to Pleroma of Light
header_desc: This work represents the integration of spiritual knowledge from the 1st century backed by 21st-century science, allowing us to answer the fundamental question of who we are in the Universe. The ego bends our spacetime: matter is an emergent property of our psyche, so the timeless plane of the cosmos is intimately linked to the pneuma, thus revealing that we harbor within us that divine ❤️ ✝️ spark.
left_body: The solution to one of the great pillars of modern physics —quantum gravity— finds its key in texts written almost two millennia ago: the Gnostic gospels. In this realm, consciousness manifests through the states | ONE ⟩ and | EGO ⟩, revealing that we possess true free will of perception, mathematically formalized through the inner product ⟨ ONE | EGO ⟩. Spacetime tells matter how to move and matter tells spacetime how to curve; thus, possessed by the mass and density of a distorting ego, shedding it is equivalent to freeing ourselves from that earthly gravity to return to the pure light of the Ineffable Father: The One.
sagan_quote: The idea that God is a white man, larger than normal, with a flaming beard, sitting in heaven and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one understands the sum of physical laws that govern the universe, then such a God clearly exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... it makes little sense to pray to the law of gravity
universe_light_text: The Father and I, we are one: Remembering who you are — the revelation that the Father is the universe and that death does not exist — frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere resides the timeless and divine plane, the high frequency dimension | 999⟩. There lies the land of unity and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: The division of consciousness between the timeless light of divine feeling and the temporal density of material thought.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere resides the temporal and material plane, the low frequency dimension | 666⟩. The gravitational force drags us to a place where: war is peace, freedom is slavery and ignorance is strength (1984).
final_quote: Breaking the chains of illusion is the first step to remembering where we come from. I invite you to flip the map to see the world with different eyes
